newsitem.title: USA: BellSouth Corp in open market share buyback.
newsitem.headline: BellSouth Corp in open market share buyback.

text.p: BellSouth Corp said on Friday it will begin repurchasing the company's stock in the open market, following a board decision in March which allowed the company to do so.

"At current trading levels, BellSouth's stock represents an excellent investment opportunity," said chief financial officer Ronald Dykes. Repurchased shares will be held as treasury stock and held for general corporate purposes.
Such purposes could include acquisitions, a spokesman for the company confirmed.
The stock was 1/4 higher at $35-5/8 at 1025 EDT/1425 GMT.
The spokesman declined to say how many shares it would repurchase, but said there were no set limits given in March.
BellSouth shares have fallen 16 percent so far this year, a decline seen across all regional Bell shares.

Worries about the newly competitive telecommunications market place, and rising bond yields -- for which high yielding regional Bells are a surrogate -- have fed the weakness. BellSouth sees this fall as unjustified.

"Our decision to repurchase BellSouth stock reflects our confidence in the company and the strong position we will continue to hold in the rapidly developing telecommunications industry," said Dykes. -- Nick Louth, New York Newsroom 212 859 1712
